content: Current MCP cancellation specification says an in-progress tools/call may be cancelled with notifications/cancelled carrying the original request ID and optional reason; receivers should stop processing, free resources, and send no response, while handling races where cancellation arrives after completion. MCP debugging guidance says stdio servers must log diagnostics to stderr, not stdout, and recommends MCP Inspector plus host logs and lifecycle/performance instrumentation. The specification does not establish a universal five-minute host deadline, so a Codex-specific timeout must be measured from host logs or controlled harnesses.
